Past Auctions

At SDL Property Auctions, we publish the results of the properties sold in our auction events as they are sold. We choose to publish our past auction results as we understand these are a valuable resource for property investors to gauge the interest in different types of properties available or the interest in specific areas. These results can also help those looking to sell their property to see what similar lots have sold for, allowing them to see the potential that selling at auction offers.

Browse through the comprehensive list below showing our past auctions which feature realised auction sold prices with their initial guide prices. To find out more about the property auction results of a specific lot, simply click on the day of its respective event below. Alternatively, if you are looking to sell your property by auction, browse through the different auction events to find similar properties and their final sale prices.
